title: Merge intervals (greedy)
summary: Sort by start, then sweep once: extend the last merged interval while the next one overlaps it.
note: Each interval is [start, end] with start ≤ end; touching intervals like [1, 3] and [3, 5] count as overlapping.

narration.text: Sort by start: now anything that overlaps must overlap the last merged interval.
It starts at {start}, before the last merged interval ends at {merged[len(merged) - 1][1]}: they overlap.
Nothing merged yet, so this interval starts the list.
It starts at {start}, after the last merged interval ends: no overlap, so it starts a new one.
Stretch the last merged interval: it now ends at {merged[len(merged) - 1][1]}.
